messages:
jonathan: Heads-up — after the CNI upgrade in cluster eu-west-1a we started seeing GPU nodepools fail to join the autoscaler. Pods stuck in Pending with 'no available IPs' and some new nodes show taints that differ from the gitops config. Anyone else seeing this?

maria: yep saw alerts at 08:13 UTC, looked like the kube-controller-manager logs show failures claiming the cloud-provider IP allocator returned 0 available addresses.

alex: quick summary of what changed: we rolled calico 3.25 -> 3.26 via helm in the cluster-canary stage. The helm values added the 'allocatorShim: true' flag (PR #4127). My suspicion is allocatorShim is enabling a new IPAM path that expects a different subnet tag.

jonathan: exact symptoms: GPU nodes start, kubelet registers, but pods with hostNetwork: false go Pending. kubectl describe pod shows "failed to assign IP: allocator responded empty". Some nodes also come up with taint key gpu-provisioner=warm:NoSchedule but gitops wants gpu-provisioner=reserved:NoSchedule.

tanvi: can you paste the helm values from the canary? I want to see the allocator block.

alex: sure — from the canary release: ```yaml
cni:
  calico:
    enabled: true
    allocatorShim: true
    allocator:
      subnetTags: ["k8s-eu-west-1a-primary"]
```

maria: and our nodepool module in terraform sets node labels/taints via gitops helm chart values: ```hcl
module "gpu_nodepool" {
  source = "git::git@repo/infra-modules.git//nodepool"
  taints = [{key="gpu-provisioner", value="reserved", effect="NoSchedule"}]
}
```

jonathan: so allocatorShim is looking for tag "k8s-eu-west-1a-primary" but our subnet tagging script uses a different tag value "k8s-eu-west-1a" (no -primary). That mismatch would make the allocator think there are no IP ranges, hence 0 IPs.

sre-bot: Alert: 2 GPU nodepools in eu-west-1a failing autoscale (nodes NotReady/Pending) — incident created: INC-2026-8243

tanvi: if that's the case the quick remediation is to: 1) revert allocatorShim in the calico chart to false for canary, 2) trigger a gitops re-sync for nodepool tags OR 3) patch subnet tags to include the -primary alias. Which is least risky?

alex: patching subnet tags is low-risk but requires cloud infra permission and may affect other clusters. Reverting the helm flag is fastest for canary and will stop new nodes from being created with the shim enabled. We should also fix upstream tag detection in infra repo.

maria: I'm going to open a fast PR to flip allocatorShim back in the canary chart (will reference the canary release ID). If someone can handle tagging or the tf change I can coordinate rollback. @jonathan can you own the terraform tag fix?

jonathan: I can. I'll prepare a small terraform run to add the alias tag and also send a change to the subnet tagging module to support both tag variants. Will leave as a short-lived fix until infra-modules PR lands.

alex: thanks — I'm also going to add a validation in the helm chart that errors if allocatorShim=true and subnetTags is empty, to avoid silent failures. Will push as PR #4182.

sre-bot: Run request: deploy-bot, roll calico canary back to 3.25 -> deploy started by maria at 1845032205

deploy-bot: Deploy log: canary rollback in progress (release canary-calico-2). Pod-by-pod recreation. Monitoring IP allocation metrics.

maria: rollback applied, cluster-canary now stable (pods scheduling) — initial checks look good. I left the incident muted but keeping the thread open until terraform fix is in.

jonathan: terraform plan to add alias tag looks clean, will apply after lunch. Plan snippet: ```diff
  resource "aws_subnet" "k8s" {
    tags = merge(var.tags, {"k8s-cluster":"redwood-eu-west-1a", "k8s-role":"worker"})
+   // add compatibility alias
+   tags = merge(var.tags, {"k8s-eu-west-1a-primary":"true"})
  }
```

tanvi: ping when applied so we can promote calico 3.26 with allocatorShim enabled in non-canary clusters. Prefer to keep allocatorShim on long term once tags are consistent.

alex: agreed — allocatorShim reduces IP churn for our workloads. We'll add unit tests in infra-modules to validate tags mapping.

maria: thanks all. Lessons: ensure helm/allocator feature flags align with infra tagging conventions before rollout. Also adding a preflight check in our gitops pipeline to detect empty allocator subnets would have prevented this. I'll file a follow-up ticket. :memo:

jonathan: FYI incident INC-2026-8243 closed — root cause: allocatorShim tag mismatch; mitigated by calico canary rollback + subnet tag alias. Moving the terraform change to a normal CL.
